text.p: Stefanel Milan defeated rivals and fellow Italians Kinder Bologna 67-59 in the first leg of their last 16 men's Euroleague tie on Thursday.
Stefanel powered their way to victory thanks to the inspiration of pivot Gregor Fucka who top-scored for them with 23 points.
Kinder, who trailed 37-29 at halftime, played well in the first half with strong performances by Kostos Patavoukas, who scored a total of 16 points, and pivot Zoran Savic, who scored 12.
But 10 minutes into the second half, Stefanel opened up their biggest lead of the night -- 16 points -- and never looked like letting the match slip.
The teams are due to meet in the second leg in Bologna on Tuesday.
